question:
Alice, Bob, Claire, Dave, and Eve are playing a game. At the start of the game, they are each holding a ball: Alice has a yellow ball, Bob has a white ball, Claire has a purple ball, Dave has a pink ball, and Eve has a brown ball.
As the game progresses, pairs of players trade balls. First, Bob and Claire swap balls. Then, Alice and Eve swap balls. Then, Bob and Dave swap balls. Then, Bob and Dave swap balls. Finally, Bob and Claire swap balls. At the end of the game, Eve has the
Options:
(A) yellow ball
(B) white ball
(C) purple ball
(D) pink ball
(E) brown ball
solution:
Ball colors in player order (Alice, Bob, Claire, Dave, Eve):
Initial: (yellow, white, purple, pink, brown)
1. Bob and Claire swap: (yellow, purple, white, pink, brown)
2. Alice and Eve swap: (brown, purple, white, pink, yellow)
3. Bob and Dave swap: (brown, pink, white, purple, yellow)
4. Bob and Dave swap: (brown, purple, white, pink, yellow)
5. Bob and Claire swap: (brown, white, purple, pink, yellow)
Eve has the yellow ball, option (A).
Final answer: (A)
